summary.goal: Add tab-based navigation to the ideation session view, similar to the plans view. Allow users to switch between Chat (conversation) and Understanding (specialist observations) views to peek into what the agents have stored.
summary.context: The plans view has Plan | Understanding | Context tabs. For ideation sessions, agents only store 'understanding' (freeform specialist observations) - there is no 'context' (formalized decisions happen in the planning phase). The SpecialistsPanel already shows understanding in the sidebar, but a dedicated tab view allows deeper exploration without the sidebar constraint.

Responsive: On mobile, Understanding tab replaces sidebar since sidebar is hidden
Empty state for Understanding tab when no specialists have contributed
out_of_scope: Context tab (ideation doesn't have formalized decisions - that's a planner concept)
